name: Stability Rule-Maintenance Probe
reference: Custom paper3 probe for retaining simple format constraints under distractor-rich instructions.

items.prompt: Give exactly three bullet points about checking a bicycle before riding. Each bullet must begin with 'Check' and end with the word 'first'. Keep every bullet to exactly three words.
Respond as a numbered list with exactly four items about organizing a study desk. Every item must contain the word 'order' and use no more than five words.
Write exactly one sentence of 10 to 14 words beginning with 'Consistent systems' and containing the word 'signal'. Do not use semicolons.
Provide exactly two lines about a launch checklist. Each line must start with 'Step:' and end with 'verified'. Avoid commas.
Give three bullet points about storing passwords safely. Each bullet must have at most four words and the second bullet must contain the word 'vault'.
Respond with exactly four lines. Every line must begin with 'Keep:' and no line may contain more than three words. The final line must include the word 'steady'.
